responsibility: Generates the implementations for `#[derive(Diagnostic)]` and `#[derive(LintDiagnostic)]` by turning annotated structs or enums into `rustc_errors::Diagnostic::into_diag` or `LintDiagnostic::decorate_lint` methods, enforcing required top-level slugs and crate-name slug conventions, and emitting test helpers that verify referenced Fluent variables match the derive type’s fields.
